method: physical structure is evaluated directly; the conditional proxy layer uses pre-tournament Elo-complete match mapping, capacity-only venue mapping, deterministic tournament-progress time mapping, and one common envelope Min-Max domain

source_contract.official_verification: FIFA schedule, scores, stadium capacity and address pages

rest_min_hours.denominator: 全部球队相邻两轮间隔
rest_min_hours.definition: 球队相邻比赛 UTC 间隔的最小值

rest_mean_hours.denominator: 全部球队相邻两轮间隔
rest_mean_hours.definition: 球队相邻比赛 UTC 间隔的平均值

timezone_crossings.denominator: 全部球队相邻两轮间隔
timezone_crossings.definition: 相邻比赛场馆 UTC 偏移发生变化的次数

timezone_crossing_rate.definition: 跨时区次数除以球队转场次数

travel_mean_km.definition: 相邻比赛实际场馆大圆距离的平均值

venue_change_rate.definition: 相邻轮更换场馆的球队转场比例

venue_utilization_rate.denominator: 启用场馆数乘比赛日期数
venue_utilization_rate.definition: 发生比赛的场馆日占可用场馆日比例

venue_daily_peak.definition: 单一场馆单日承办场次最大值

capacity_occupancy_rate.definition: 预计现场观众与场馆容量之比的场均值

prime_coverage_rate.definition: 按赛事进度日和 UTC 钟点映射后落入前四分位时段的比例

expected_attendance_per_match.definition: 预计现场观众总量除以比赛场次

overall_conclusion: 综合方向在已检验权重和邻居代理下稳定，但仍为条件性结论
proxy_note: 结构层报告物理量；代理层用完整赛前Elo映射比赛、仅按容量和安保可行域映射场馆，黄金时段按赛事进度日与UTC钟点唯一映射；T/B/C在全部报告场景共用的包络边界上归一化。
